resources.string: These voice apps require an ARM64 phone. After installing, return to CuevaReader and choose the voice under Change voice.
These downloads are not compatible with this device. Use SherpaTTS from the help section instead.
These voice downloads use the same Android app. Installing another replaces the currently installed direct voice; only one can be installed this way at a time.

To listen with a voice other than the Google voice on your phone, download a separate voice engine. The links above install engines like separate apps.

To explore more voices, we recommend SherpaTTS.

1. Download F-Droid from https://f-droid.org/ and install its APK. If Android asks, allow your browser to install unknown apps.
2. Open F-Droid and wait for its catalogue to update.
3. Search for SherpaTTS, by org.woheller69.ttsengine, and install it: https://f-droid.org/packages/org.woheller69.ttsengine/
4. Open SherpaTTS, download a voice for your language, and return to CuevaReader. Choose it under Change voice.
